cards.name: Fractal Noise
cards.summary: Generates procedural greyscale cloud / turbulence noise that replaces or blends over the layer. The workhorse for smoke, fog, light-leak textures, flicker mattes and organic displacement maps.
use_for: slow drifting fog / haze layer over a trailer title (Screen or Overlay blend)
animated texture behind lower thirds and news-graphics backplates
luma matte for an organic dissolve / burn-in transition
displacement source for heat-haze or glitch warps (Displacement Map)
subtle light flicker on a documentary archival photo
avoid: full-opacity Normal blend replaces the footage with grey noise; drop Opacity or put it on a solid with a layer blend mode
high Complexity with tiny Scale reads as cheap TV static; keep Scale 200+ for atmosphere
animating Offset Turbulence fast looks like sliding wallpaper; animate Evolution instead

params.name: Fractal Type
params.does: noise character preset (Basic, Turbulent Smooth, Dynamic, Rocky, Strings ...)
params.typical: 1 (Basic) for fog; try other indices for wispy/sharp textures

params.name: Noise Type
params.typical: 3 Soft Linear (default) or 4 Spline for smooth smoke

params.name: Scale
params.does: size of the noise pattern (Uniform Scaling on)
params.typical: 200-600 for fog and smoke, 30-80 for grit

params.name: Evolution
params.typical: animate 0 -> 360-720 over 10 s, or expression time*40

params.name: Opacity
params.does: mix of the noise over the original layer

cards.equivalent: Premiere: none native in v26; closest is VR Fractal Noise (Immersive Video bin, built for 360 frames)
cards.scripting: Usually applied to a full-frame solid (black solid 1920x1080) and composited with the layer's blend mode (Screen/Overlay/Add); applied to footage it overwrites pixels unless Opacity < 100 or the effect's own Blending Mode is changed. Blending Mode popup: 1 None, 2 Normal (default), 4 Add, 5 Multiply, 6 Screen, 7 Overlay ... (separators at 3, 10, 13, 18); Fractal Type: 1 Basic, 3 Turbulent Smooth, 4 Turbulent Basic, 5 Turbulent Sharp, 7 Dynamic ... 20 Threads (separators at 2, 6, 10); both in enum_labels (read from After Effects 26.0). Evolution and Rotation are angles in degrees with no harvested limits. Scale Width/Scale Height only act when Uniform Scaling = 0. For a seamless loop set Cycle Evolution = 1 and Cycle (in Revolutions) to the evolution turns.

verified.note: Grey cloudy fractal fog blended over the whole frame at about half opacity, image still readable underneath.

cards.name: Match Grain
cards.summary: Samples the film grain / sensor noise of another layer and adds matching grain to this layer, so CG, graphics or clean stock sit in the same plate.
use_for: make a clean CG element or AI shot match the grain of the live-action plate
give clean stock / screen-recorded inserts the same noise as camera footage in a documentary
unify grain after Remove Grain + compositing (degrain, comp, regrain)
avoid: without a grainy Noise Source Layer there is nothing to match; use Add Grain instead
Viewing Mode defaults to Preview (only a small box); the full frame shows nothing until set to Final Output
slow to render on long timelines; pre-render the regrained layer

params.name: Viewing Mode
params.does: Preview box / sample views / Final Output

params.name: Intensity
params.does: strength multiplier on the matched grain

params.name: Amount
params.does: Blend with Original amount (keeps some of the clean layer)

cards.scripting: Noise Source Layer is a 'layer' property: an AdobeBridge spec cannot set it (pve check rejects layer props), so the build needs a custom ExtendScript line effect.property('Noise Source Layer').setValue(plateLayer.index). Viewing Mode defaults to 1 (Preview); set 5 (Final Output) or only the preview box is processed. Viewing Mode: 1 Preview, 2 Noise Samples, 3 Compensation Samples, 4 Blending Matte, 5 Final Output (read from After Effects 26.0). All groups in this effect are flat header rows, so 'Group/Property' does not disambiguate: a repeated name always resolves to its FIRST occurrence. The sample-point names '1'..'10' exist twice (Noise Sample Points, then Intensity points); only the first set is reachable by name and '1#2' style names do not work in After Effects. Sample points auto-place; leave them alone. Blending Mode: 1 Film, 2 Multiply, 3 Add (default), 4 Screen, 5 Overlay (read from After Effects 26.0).

verified.note: Card is needs_input (needs a grain source layer), so no gallery frame exists.

cards.name: Median
cards.summary: Replaces each pixel with the median of its neighbours within Radius: removes speckle noise at low radius and turns the image into a flat, painterly watercolour look at high radius.
use_for: light speckle / dust cleanup on low-res archival footage (Radius 1-2)
painterly / illustrated look for a stylised flashback or explainer background
smooth a luma matte or key edge before using it as a matte
abstract 'memory' look on a documentary reenactment
avoid: on faces Radius > 4 wipes skin detail into plastic
large radius on 4K is slow; work at 1080 or pre-render

params.name: Operate On Alpha Channel
params.does: also median-filters the alpha (0 off, 1 on)
params.typical: 0 for footage, 1 to clean a matte

cards.equivalent: Premiere: none in v26 (no Median effect in the harvested list)
cards.scripting: Newer replacement for 'Median (Legacy)' (ADBE Median); same two properties. Operate On Alpha Channel is a checkbox (0/1). Radius is in layer pixels, so the same value looks weaker on higher-res sources.

verified.note: Detail is smeared flat: faces, flowers and stripes turn into smooth painterly blobs, no blur halo.

cards.name: Median (Legacy)
cards.summary: The older Median filter: replaces each pixel with the median of its neighbours, removing speckle at low radius and painting the image at high radius. Kept for old projects.
use_for: opening legacy projects that already use it
speckle cleanup on archival footage when matching an old render exactly
avoid: use the current 'Median' (ADBE PS Median) in new builds
cards.equivalent: AE replacement: Median (ADBE PS Median); Premiere: none in v26
cards.scripting: Superseded by Median (match ADBE PS Median) with identical property names; scripts should apply ADBE PS Median instead. If kept, Radius (0-255) and Operate On Alpha Channel (0/1) work the same.

verified.note: Same painterly smoothing as Median at Radius 10, faces and flowers flattened into smooth patches.

cards.name: Noise
cards.summary: Adds random per-pixel noise that changes every frame, in colour or monochrome. A quick video-noise / dirty-signal texture rather than true film grain.
use_for: CCTV / surveillance / leaked-footage look on a news reel (with desaturation)
break up banding on gradient backgrounds and big blurs (2-4%)
quick grit on a VHS / archive pastiche
noise burst on a glitch transition
avoid: above ~15% it reads as cheap TV static, not film grain; use Add Grain for filmic grain
colour noise on skin looks like a bad sensor; prefer Noise Type 0 (mono) on faces

params.name: Clipping
params.does: checkbox: clip result values (0 lets noise wash the image)

cards.scripting: Noise Type and Clipping are checkboxes exposed as 0/1 numbers (Noise Type 1 = Use Color Noise). Noise re-randomises every frame automatically, no keyframes needed.

verified.note: At Amount 50 (was 25) a fine colour speckle now covers the whole frame, clearly visible on the walls, dark clothing and stripes even at preview size, reading as a dirty video signal where the old render was barely distinguishable from the reference.

cards.name: Noise Alpha
cards.summary: Adds random noise to the layer's alpha channel, punching speckled transparent holes (or speckled opacity) so whatever is below shows through. Used for disintegration and dusty, eroded mattes.
use_for: noisy dissolve / disintegrate transition between two shots (animate Amount)
eroded, dusty edge on a title or stamp graphic
speckled matte for a 'breaking up' archival photo in a documentary
avoid: on a single layer over black it just looks like black dots; needs a different layer underneath
uniform noise on large areas looks digital; blur the result slightly or use Fractal Noise as a matte instead

params.name: Noise
params.does: noise kind: Uniform Random, Squared Random (static) or Uniform / Squared Animation (moving)
params.typical: 1 (Uniform Random, default) or 2 (Squared Random, higher contrast); the Animation variants sit at higher indices (see scripting)

params.name: Amount
params.does: amount of alpha noise in percent
params.typical: 20-80; animate 0 -> 100 and finish with an opacity fade for a full dissolve

params.name: Original Alpha
params.does: where the noise goes: Add (everywhere), Clamp (opaque areas only), Scale (by opacity), Edges (semi-transparent edges only)
params.typical: 2 Clamp (default) on footage; 4 Edges to rough up a title's edges

params.name: Contextual Control
params.does: random seed / noise phase of the pattern (degrees)

cards.equivalent: Premiere: none in v26 (no Noise Alpha effect in the harvested list)
cards.scripting: Only alpha changes, so the result is visible only over another layer or a coloured comp background. 'Contextual Control' is the harvested name of the seed/phase control (UI label reads Random Seed for the Random noise types and Noise Phase for the Animation types); animate it to change a static pattern. Original Alpha (1 Add, 2 Clamp, 3 Scale, 4 Edges), Overflow (1 Clip, 2 Wrap Back, 3 Wrap) and Noise (1 Uniform Random, 2 Squared Random, 3 a separator, 4 Uniform Animation, 5 Squared Animation) are read from After Effects 26.0. Cycle Noise (0/1) with Cycle (in Revolutions) makes the animated noise loop.

verified.note: Fine speckled transparent holes over the whole layer let the black background through, giving a darker dusty, eroded texture.

cards.name: Noise HLS
cards.summary: Adds noise separately to hue, lightness and saturation, with an optional grain mode and grain size. Gives colour speckle, luminance grain or psychedelic hue noise; static unless Noise Phase is animated.
use_for: controllable luminance grain (Lightness only) on a gritty explainer or trailer
colour-speckle damage for a corrupted-file / glitch beat
textured grain on flat motion-graphics backgrounds
avoid: Hue noise above ~10 looks like rainbow confetti on skin
static noise pattern looks like a dirty lens unless Noise Phase is animated (or use Noise HLS Auto)

params.name: Noise
params.does: noise kind: Uniform, Squared or Grain

params.name: Noise Phase
params.does: seed/phase of the pattern in degrees
params.typical: animate via expression time*360 to make it crawl

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Noise (no HLS variant in v26)
cards.scripting: Noise is a 3-item popup (1 Uniform, 2 Squared, 3 Grain). Grain Size only matters when Noise = 3. Noise Phase has no harvested range (angle in degrees); keyframe or expression it, otherwise the noise is frozen.

verified.note: Clearly visible coarse luminance grain with slight colour speckle across the frame.

cards.name: Noise HLS Auto
cards.summary: Same hue / lightness / saturation noise as Noise HLS, but it animates automatically at a set speed, so it behaves like live grain without keyframes.
use_for: moving luminance grain over a trailer or documentary sequence with no keyframing
animated grain on motion-graphics backgrounds so they do not look sterile
gritty texture on a CCTV / found-footage pastiche
avoid: Hue noise on faces looks like confetti; keep Hue near 0
very high speed + large grain reads as boiling static

params.name: Noise
params.does: noise kind: Uniform, Squared or Grain

params.name: Noise Animation Speed
params.does: how fast the pattern changes (roughly changes per second)

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Noise (no HLS variant in v26)
cards.scripting: Static values only; animation is automatic from Noise Animation Speed (0 freezes it). Noise popup: 1 Uniform, 2 Squared, 3 Grain; Grain Size only applies with 3.

verified.note: Same visible coarse luminance grain with light colour speckle as Noise HLS (animation not judgeable from one frame).

cards.name: Remove Grain
cards.summary: Analyses the grain/noise in sampled flat areas and removes it, with optional temporal filtering and sharpening. A denoiser for noisy low-light footage and the degrain step before compositing.
use_for: clean noisy night / low-light interview or rally footage before grading
degrain a plate before keying or compositing, then Match Grain after
reduce compression noise on downloaded news clips before upscaling
soften blotchy skin noise on phone footage
avoid: Viewing Mode defaults to Preview (a small box); set Final Output or the full frame is untouched
high Noise Reduction / many Passes gives plastic, waxy faces
very slow; pre-render long clips

params.name: Viewing Mode
params.does: Preview box / Noise Samples / Blending Matte / Final Output

params.name: Passes
params.does: number of filter passes (more = removes larger grain)

params.name: Amount
params.does: Temporal Filtering amount (the FIRST 'Amount'; the only one reachable by name, see scripting)

cards.scripting: Set Viewing Mode = 4 (Final Output) FIRST; default 1 only processes the preview box. 'Amount' repeats three times (Temporal Filtering 0-100, Unsharp Mask 0-5, Blend with Original 0-100). The groups are flat header rows, so AdobeBridge resolves both 'Amount' and 'Unsharp Mask/Amount' to the FIRST one (Temporal Filtering), and 'Amount#2' is simply not found in After Effects; the Unsharp Mask and Blend amounts cannot be set from a spec. To sharpen after degraining, add a separate Unsharp Mask effect after Remove Grain. Noise sample points 1-10 auto-place; Sample Selection: 1 Automatic, 2 Manual (read from After Effects 26.0). Mask Layer is a layer reference (not spec-settable). Mode: 1 Multichannel, 2 Single Channel (read from After Effects 26.0). The demo values deliberately over-smooth so the effect is visible; real use stays near Noise Reduction 1, Passes 3.

verified.note: Final Output mode smooths the whole frame strongly, removing texture to a soft, waxy look.

cards.name: Turbulent Noise
cards.summary: A faster, GPU-friendly version of Fractal Noise: procedural cloud/turbulence noise with an extra Turbulence Factor but fewer sub-settings. Same uses: fog, smoke, organic textures and mattes.
use_for: animated fog / smoke overlay on trailer titles (Screen blend)
organic luma matte for a burn or ink transition
moving texture under news-graphics panels
displacement source for heat-haze or warp effects
avoid: at Opacity 100 with Normal blend it hides the footage completely
no Cycle Evolution, so it cannot loop seamlessly; use Fractal Noise for looping backgrounds
no Sub Rotation / Sub Offset; use Fractal Noise when those are needed

params.name: Turbulence Factor
params.does: how strongly the noise is churned/distorted

cards.equivalent: Premiere: none native in v26; closest is VR Fractal Noise (Immersive Video bin, built for 360 frames)
cards.scripting: Same property names as Fractal Noise minus Sub Rotation, Sub Offset, Center Subscale and Cycle Evolution, plus Turbulence Factor (1-4). Blending Mode popup: 1 None, 2 Normal (default), 4 Add, 5 Multiply, 6 Screen ... (enum_labels). Evolution and Rotation are degrees with no harvested limits. Noise Type (1 Block, 2 Linear, 3 Soft Linear, 4 Spline) and Overflow (1 Clip, 2 Soft Clamp, 3 Wrap Back, 4 Allow HDR Results) are read from this effect's own menus in After Effects 26.0 (they match Fractal Noise).

verified.note: Grey turbulent cloud/smoke texture blended over the frame at about half opacity.

cards.name: Basic 3D
cards.summary: Tilts and swivels a layer in pseudo-3D space and pushes it toward/away from the viewer, with an optional specular glint. Superseded by making the layer a real 3D layer with a camera.
use_for: legacy projects only
quick card tilt in a 2D comp where a 3D layer is not wanted
avoid: use the layer's 3D switch (plus a camera) for new builds; Basic 3D ignores comp cameras and lights
Specular Highlight looks dated

params.name: Distance to Image
params.does: moves the layer toward (negative) or away from the viewer

cards.equivalent: AE replacement: the layer's 3D switch plus a camera; Premiere: Basic 3D (same AE effect)
cards.scripting: Obsolete: prefer layer.threeDLayer = true and animating Orientation / X-Y Rotation. If used, Swivel and Tilt are degrees with no harvested limits; Specular Highlight and Preview are 0/1 checkboxes; leave Preview 0 for renders.

verified.note: Layer is swivelled and tilted in perspective, its edges pulled in to reveal black on the left and bottom.

cards.name: Basic Text
cards.summary: Legacy (Obsolete category) effect that renders text typed into a modal dialog onto the layer. Superseded by native text layers; unusable from scripts here because applying it opens a modal Edit Text dialog and the harvest could read no properties.
use_for: legacy projects only; create text layers for any new title or caption
avoid: text is set in a modal dialog, so scripts cannot set the text content through properties
applying it from an unattended build opens that modal dialog and stalls After Effects (pve/dialog_watchdog.py exists to cancel it during harvests)
no per-character animators or proper typography
cards.equivalent: AE replacement: text layer (comp.layers.addText / addBoxText); Premiere: Essential Graphics / Type tool text or the Text effect
cards.scripting: Harvest failed with 'TypeError: null is not an object', so no properties are known; do not apply from scripts. Use comp.layers.addText() / addBoxText() instead.

verified.note: Card is unusable (modal Edit Text dialog, no readable properties), so no gallery frame exists.
